content: Hipatɨ wakwie
Kepauka mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie 'ixaheritsixi memɨte'uta'aitaxɨ, yunaitɨ mekaniuyukuxeɨrieni Tsiru mɨrakutewatsie, 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwekai.
'Ana tukaritsie 'akuxi mekaniyuhayewatɨwekaitɨni me'atahutatɨ wa'iwama mekaheixeiyatɨ yukwie.
Hikɨ Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ 'ixaheritsixi katiniwarutahɨawe: «¿Kepaukake xeme yukwietsie xepɨyehu Yawé mɨxexatɨa xe'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari?
Yuhahaikakame xekeniwarutihɨawixɨa nemɨwaranɨnɨ'anikɨ memɨnieriyukɨ xapatsie memɨte'aka'utɨanikɨ. Me'axɨame,
mekaniti'inɨatakuni kwie 'atahuta paɨmeme. Kura xehetɨa kanikunakamɨkɨ yukwie, Kutse xiɨyarimamata wayeta.
Kepauka xemeinɨni xe'i'utɨatɨ xekeneneyetuiri, nekanixeyetuiriemɨkɨ 'inɨarikɨ kemɨ'anetsie mɨtinake Yawé hɨxie takakaɨyari.

Xekatenimaikari, rewitsixi kwie mepɨkayetuiriyarieni nixewitɨ tɨma, mɨkɨ pɨta 'uximayatsika memɨyetuiriyariekɨ mawari wewiwamete memɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ Yawé hetsiemieme. Meta Kahari, Xuweni meta hixɨapa memɨ'axe Manatsexi wanuiwarima 'ari mekaniyetuiriyarieni yukwie Kurutani 'anutaɨye tau manatineika hepatsie. Muitsexi Yawé ti'uximayatsiriwame kaniwayetuirieni wapiini mɨrayanikɨ».

Kepauka 'ukitsi memuyuha'aritɨakai menieriyuka mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie, Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Naime kwie xekenexeiya ya'ane xepɨnetsi 'atɨirieni xapatsie raye'ukame. Kepauka xemɨ'axɨani 'ena Tsiru, ne 'inɨarikɨ kwie nepɨxeta'iwitsitɨani Yawé hɨxie».
Mɨkɨ yametenikakɨne Kutsuhexi kemainekai, mekanakunuaxɨani Tsirutsie xapa mehahurietɨ raye'ukame, kiekari kemɨreumanetɨkatei meta 'atahuta tapari kwie 'inɨariyari.
Kutsuhexi mana kaniwaruta'iwitsitɨani Yawé hɨxie, kaniwaruxatɨani kwie mɨkɨ 'ixaheritsixi, kememuyukupapaɨmekai nuiwarite.
Wenikamini kwieya
Wenikamini xiɨyarimama mekaniuxatɨarieni kememuyupaɨmekai niwemama. Mɨkɨ kwieyari kanikumakaitɨni Kura kwieyari makuma meta Kutse xiɨyarimama wakwie makuma wahixɨapa.
Wakwie manuye'atɨka katini'anekaitɨni haa manuyeka Kurutani, meta Keriku heima kaniye'atɨkateitɨni, hɨritsie kaneutiyunekaitɨni, makumawetsie Weti-'Aweni ye'atɨkaitɨ.
Rutsi mɨrakutewa kaneuyeyunekaitɨni, meta Weteri mɨrakutewa, 'Ataruti-'Araxi mɨrakutewapai heutayunetɨ, Weti-Kuruni tsutɨa mukuma hɨriyaritsie heutayunetɨ.

Manata hɨkɨa pɨta kaneukayunekaitɨni, tau manukayuyuipiketsie, ye'atɨkaitɨ Kiriati-Wahari, mɨtitewatsiere Kiriati-Yeharini, mɨkɨ Kiekari Kura mɨrawiya pɨhɨkɨtɨkai. 'Ikɨ pɨhɨkɨ tau makayuyuipike muyeka.
Tsutɨa muyekatsie nitsutɨkaitɨni Kiriati-Yeharini, tau makayuyuipiketsie, manata haixa matiniere Netuhaki ye'atɨ.

Weni-Hinuni hɨriyaritsie kaniukuhanekaitɨni, Xepahini mɨrayetewa heima. Hinuni mayeweritsie kaniuyehanekaitɨni, Kewutseutsixi wakiekari 'aurie mukɨatsarietsie, 'Enixukeri haixayari matiniere paitɨ kaniye'akaitɨni.
Manata kanititunekaitɨni teikɨmana hautiyunetɨ, 'Enitsemetsi kiekari makuma hepa, Keriruti kaniuyehanekaitɨni, 'Arumini hɨxie kaniuyehanekaitɨni, Wuhani Xuweni nu'aya 'aiyaritsie kaneukayunekaitɨni.
Manata kaneutayunekaitɨni hɨri matitei yeta, Weti-'Arawa mɨrayetewatsie hɨxie, manata 'Arawa mayeweritsie kaneukayunekaitɨni.
Manata Weti-Kukura yeta, manata mukuweritsie yeta Haramara Mɨmɨki hatetsitayaritsie, tatsɨari hatuxame Kurutani manuyenieretsie. Mɨkɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni kwie kemɨreu'atɨka wahetɨatsie.
Kurutani hatuxameyari kani'inɨaritɨkaitɨni kemɨreukatei, kwie kemɨreu'atɨkatei tau manatineika hepatsie. 'Ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni Wenikamini xiɨyarimama wakwie kemɨreu'atɨkatei.
Wenikamini xiɨyarimama 'ikɨ kiekaritsie mekaniuyuhayewa: Keriku, Weti-Kukura, 'Emeki-Katsitsi,
Weti-'Arawa, Tsemarahini, Weteri,
'Awini, Paraha, 'Upɨra,
Kepaxi-'Amuni, 'Uhuni meta Kehewa, naitɨri tamamata heimana huta kiekariyari yu'aurie heixeiyatɨ 'etsiyeyeume.
Meta Kawahuni, Xama, Weruti,
Mitsipa, Kapira, Mutsa,
Xekeni, 'Ixiperi, Tarara,

Tsera, 'Erepa, Kewutsi, mɨtitewatsiere Kerutsareme, Kiweya, meta Kiriati, naitɨ tamamata heimana nauka kiekariyari yu'aurie heixeiyakame 'etsiyeyeume. 'Ikɨ memɨteyetuiriyarie Wenikamini xiɨyarimama yuxexuitɨ mepɨhɨkɨ.
